text:
Leah: Heads-up team  we need to finalize the webinar run-of-show and post-event nurture. Keep replies one-line.

Ava: Confirmed speakers: Sarah + Miguel. Ill build a compact benchmark slide + social card. Need numbers by Fri.

Priya: Sending benchmark CSV + a reproducible 45-token demo prompt. Recommend 15/25/15 + 5m Qs (55m total) to leave time for live poll and quick CTA.

Ravi: I'll own demo reliability: primary Dedicated, fallback Hosted-quant, last-resort EU warm cache. Also adding a greenroom toggle and a 30s pre-demo scrub.

Ethan: I'll moderate, run the poll, and own post-webinar SDR batching. Plan: poll intent -> immediate webhook to routing service -> SDR queues by ARR band.

Ops: Zoom->SFDC mapping ready. We will tag interest_level, demo_click, and arr_band. Recording retention 90d; transcript auto-store off by default.

Leah: Run-of-show (minutes):
0:00-0:02 Intro + housekeeping (Leah)
0:02-0:17 Keynote (Sarah)
0:17-0:42 Live demo (Miguel + Ravi)
0:42-0:57 Rapid panel (Oliver joins remotely) + live poll
0:57-0:55 Fast CTA + demo requests + close (Leah + Ethan)

Ava: Suggest adding a 60s "how-to-reproduce" slide after demo so viewers can follow the benchmark.

Priya: Agree. I'll add a short reproducibility card with CLI snippets.

Ravi: Rehearsals: tech check 30m (48h prior), dress 60m (24h prior), final mic check 15m (15m prior). Greenroom will have a 2-person ops seat to flip the toggle.

Ethan: Post-webinar flow: immediate email with infographic + 3-step demo signup. SDRs get batching every 30m for high-interest clicks.

Leah: Action items: Ava design infographic (Mon EOD); Priya reproducibility card + prompt (Fri); Ravi toggle + scrub (Wed); Ops SFDC mapping final check (Tue); Ethan nurture copy + SDR batching rules (Tue). Reply with ack.

Ava: ack

Priya: ack

Ravi: ackpushed a stub branch to rehearsals/demo-fallbacks and will ping.

Ethan: ack

Ops: ack

Leah: Thanks. Calendar invites and rehearsal links incoming. :sparkles:
